headline: AISI finds pretraining data filtering works for open-weight protein models, not durably
quote: find it to be effective and selective, but not necessarily durable against fine-tuning
claim: The UK AI Security Institute assessed pretraining data filtering as a safeguard for open-weight protein models and found it effective and selective, but not necessarily durable against fine-tuning.
why_it_matters: Shows where a common open-weights safety technique breaks, useful context if you fine-tune open models.
title: Pretraining data filtering in open-weight biological models | AISI Work

headline: AISI tests whether coding agents can rebuild biological AI tools from papers
quote: We tested whether leading coding agents can re-create published biological AI tools from limited information
claim: AISI's Chem-Bio team tested whether leading coding agents can re-create published biological AI tools from limited information, and what that means for managed access controls.
why_it_matters: Paper-to-code reproduction by agents is now a safety-evaluation question, not just a convenience.
title: Can AI coding agents rebuild biological AI tools from a paper? | AISI Work

headline: LARC reasons over continuous hidden states for image generation, tops GenEval
quote: LARC achieves state-of-the-art performance on GenEval with a 7%p gain over BAGEL
claim: LARC reasons over continuous hidden states in unified multimodal models, trained by curriculum SFT then information-gain RL, and reports a 7%p GenEval gain over BAGEL (NeurIPS 2026 comment).
why_it_matters: A readable example of latent reasoning moving beyond text-token chain-of-thought.
title: [2610.42149] Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models

headline: CEPO splits coordinator and executor prompts to improve multi-agent prompt optimization
quote: experiments spanning 11 benchmarks across four domains demonstrate that applying CEPO to four existing prompt optimizers consistently improves their performance
claim: CEPO separates a shared coordinator prompt from agent-specific executor prompts; across 11 benchmarks in four domains it improved four existing prompt optimizers.
why_it_matters: A cheap technique you can layer on whatever prompt optimizer you already use for multi-agent projects.
title: [2610.34722] CEPO: A General Framework for Improving Prompt Optimization in Multi-Agent Systems

headline: Claude Code deprecates Opus 4.8 fast mode, adds subagent effort setting
quote: Deprecated fast mode for Opus 4.8 as of October 30, 2026; it will be removed on November 30, 2026.
claim: The 31 Oct 2026 Claude Code changelog entry deprecates fast mode for Opus 4.8 (removal 30 Nov 2026, advice to migrate to Opus 5.5) and adds CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT to set subagent effort level.
why_it_matters: If your Claude Code setup uses Opus 4.8 fast mode, switch before 30 November or requests will error.
title: Claude Code changelog - Claude Code Docs
